headline: Crosby passes Bourque for most assists with one team; Canadiens still win

top.headline: Crosby passes Bourque for most assists with one team; Canadiens still win
top.summary: Sidney Crosby's 1,112th assist as a Penguin passed Ray Bourque for the most assists by a player with one team in NHL history, and his goal tied Marcel Dionne for sixth all-time in points (1,771). Montreal won 5-4 anyway behind two goals and an assist from Josh Anderson. It's the Canadiens' fifth straight win, and rookie goalie Jacob Fowler has won seven in a row.

top.headline: Wembanyama scores 43 as Spurs handle Edwards-less Wolves
top.summary: Victor Wembanyama had a season-high 43 points on 17-of-34, plus 7 rebounds and 6 blocks, in a 121-111 win over Minnesota. Dylan Harper added 25, and San Antonio has won four straight. The Wolves played without Anthony Edwards, who had a knee scope Oct. 29 and could miss up to two months, plus Rudy Gobert and Donte DiVincenzo.

top.headline: Commanders' Daron Payne done for the season
top.summary: Payne suffered a season-ending Jones fracture in his foot at Friday's practice, per ESPN's Adam Schefter, and is out for Sunday night against Philadelphia. Washington loses a starting defensive tackle with the Nov. 10 trade deadline nine days away.

stories.headline: Commanders' Daron Payne done for the season
stories.summary: Payne suffered a season-ending Jones fracture in his foot at Friday's practice, per ESPN's Adam Schefter, and is out for Sunday night against Philadelphia. Washington loses a starting defensive tackle with the Nov. 10 trade deadline nine days away.

stories.headline: Chargers put Derwin James on IR
stories.summary: James went on injured reserve with a hamstring injury and will miss at least four games. He hasn't played since Sept. 27, and Jim Harbaugh said this week he had a setback in rehab. The 0-6 Chargers play the Rams on Sunday.

stories.headline: Chiefs send L'Jarius Sneed back to IR
stories.summary: Kansas City placed Sneed on injured reserve and promoted practice-squad CB Melvin Smith. Sneed started four games after returning to the Chiefs, but his snaps had dropped the last two weeks.

stories.headline: Packers' Xavier McKinney fined $25K for criticizing officials
stories.summary: The league fined the Packers safety $25,000 for his comments on the officiating after Green Bay's loss to Detroit, per Schefter. Speaking your mind about the refs still costs real money.

stories.headline: Seahawks' Zach Charbonnet cleared for season debut
stories.summary: Charbonnet, who tore his ACL in January, is cleared to make his 2026 debut against the Bears on Monday night. Seattle has ruled out LT Charles Cross (ankle) and WR Rashid Shaheed (knee).

Dylan Harper added 25, and San Antonio has won four straight. The Wolves played without Anthony Edwards, who had a knee scope Oct. 29 and could miss up to two months, plus Rudy Gobert and Donte DiVincenzo.

stories.headline: Rockets rout banged-up Thunder
stories.summary: Houston beat Oklahoma City 119-98 a night after its first loss. Jabari Smith Jr. scored 30 and Marcus Smart hit 7 of 10 threes for 24. The Thunder, without Chet Holmgren, Jalen Williams and Cason Wallace, have lost two straight after a 4-0 start.

stories.headline: Grizzlies stay perfect, Kings stay winless
stories.summary: Memphis beat Sacramento 136-105 to move to 6-0, the league's only unbeaten team, with 81 bench points and a career-high 27 from Cameron Boozer. Rookie Darius Acuff Jr. scored a career-high 38 with nine threes for the 0-6 Kings.

stories.headline: Maxey's 38 carries 76ers with LeBron and Embiid resting
stories.summary: Tyrese Maxey scored a season-high 38 as Philadelphia came back to win 109-104 at Charlotte on the second night of a back-to-back. LeBron James (back) and Joel Embiid (foot) both sat for management and are expected back Wednesday against Indiana.

stories.headline: Cavaliers blow out slumping Bucks
stories.summary: Evan Mobley scored a season-high 27 and Jarrett Allen had 25 and 11 rebounds in Cleveland's 136-111 win in Milwaukee, the Cavs' first road win in three tries. The Bucks have lost five of six.

stories.headline: Crosby passes Bourque for most assists with one team; Canadiens still win
stories.summary: Sidney Crosby's 1,112th assist as a Penguin passed Ray Bourque for the most assists by a player with one team in NHL history, and his goal tied Marcel Dionne for sixth all-time in points (1,771). Montreal won 5-4 anyway behind two goals and an assist from Josh Anderson. It's the Canadiens' fifth straight win, and rookie goalie Jacob Fowler has won seven in a row.

stories.headline: Kucherov has three assists after trade-request report; Stamkos wins it in a shootout
stories.summary: A day after Sportsnet reported Nikita Kucherov wants out, he had three assists in Tampa's 5-4 shootout loss at Nashville. Steven Stamkos scored the tying power-play goal in the third, his first ever against his old team, then the only goal of the shootout. The Lightning still say they won't trade Kucherov.

stories.headline: McDavid runs point streak to 14 as Oilers blank Islanders
stories.summary: Connor McDavid had an assist in a 4-0 win, extending his season-opening point streak to 14 games (35 points). Ryan Nugent-Hopkins scored twice and Tristan Jarry posted his second straight shutout. Edmonton is 10-2-2, but Isaac Howard left after one shift on a knee-on-knee hit from Emil Heineman, who got a major and a game misconduct.

stories.headline: Makar's four assists drive Avalanche past Flames
stories.summary: Cale Makar had four assists and Artturi Lehkonen scored twice in Colorado's 5-2 win. Lehkonen's point streak is at nine games, and Colorado is 12-0-1 in its last 13 against Calgary.

stories.headline: Larkin-less Red Wings blow a 4-2 lead to the Blues
stories.summary: St. Louis scored three in the third, two of them 18 seconds apart, to win 5-4 in Detroit; Aleksanteri Kaskimaki's first NHL goal was the winner. Detroit played again without the suspended Dylan Larkin, who says he won't play for the team until he's traded.

standouts.name: Cale Makar
standouts.note: NHL.com says he's the second player in 30 years with four assists on Halloween.

standouts.name: Nikita Kucherov
standouts.note: Three assists in his first game since the trade-request report, in a shootout loss.

leagues.name: MLB
leagues.summary: Offseason · Astros hire Randy Flores as GM; Rays keep Rasmussen

stories.headline: Astros hire Randy Flores as GM
stories.summary: Houston hired the Cardinals assistant GM and scouting director Friday night, after Brewers AGM Matt Kleine had been reported as the top target. Flores has run St. Louis's drafts for about a decade, and his first job is finding a manager to replace Joe Espada.

stories.headline: Rays pick up Drew Rasmussen's $20MM option
stories.summary: Tampa Bay exercised Rasmussen's 2027 club option, which escalators pushed to $20MM, after a 2.67 ERA over a career-high 172 innings. MLBTR ranks him No. 2 on its offseason trade-candidate list, so keeping him may just mean keeping options open.

stories.headline: Reds let Eugenio Suárez and Pierce Johnson go; Pagán opts out
stories.summary: Cincinnati declined Suárez's $16MM mutual option and bought out Johnson's $8MM option. Closer Emilio Pagán declined his $10MM player option. The Reds' bullpen and corner infield both got thinner overnight.
